status: frozen before any generic Full-AttnRes control result
change: Add one clean, matched Full AttnRes seed-0 control for SmolVLM2-2.2B and InternVL3.5-2B.
rationale: The pre-registered ReSkip continuation rule requires comparison against both Base and a matched Full AttnRes control. Existing archived cross-decoder AttnRes checkpoints included skip-aware objectives and therefore cannot serve as clean controls.
controlled_difference: The control uses the identical pretrained model, data stream, seed, 5000 steps, learning rate 0.0002, Full-path KL objective, entropy term, adapter rank, and official six-task evaluation. The only difference is --disable-residual-strength-gate.
